span.p:
Main research question
Within InnoBeweegLab's zero-budget, standard-office-hardware setting,
what is the most efficient, cost-effective and highest-value way
to turn heterogeneous research data into a verifiably traceable,
evidence-based draft report, with the researcher in control?

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LIBRARY · Sep–Nov · done
Q Which techniques make AI-generated text traceable,
and how reliable are they?
Method literature and grey-literature review (27+ approaches)
Output background research v13

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIELD · Sep–Oct · done; interviews open
Q How is a Wijkscan report made today, and what
would let researchers verify a claim?
Method survey (n = 5), stakeholder meeting,
analysis of the Oss report and its data
Output process description, analysis artifacts

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DESIGN · Oct · done
Prototype evidence layer, drafting pipelines, verifier,
review log, Word export
Output design decisions D1–D36, 107 tests

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LAB / SQ3 · weeks 2–4
Q Which architecture gives the most traceable,
useful drafts, at what cost?
Method controlled runs on the Oss case, 3 seeds,
scored against the original report; Copilot baseline
Output H1–H5, H9

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LAB / SQ4 · weeks 2–4
Q Does the chosen configuration run on a
16 GB office laptop without a GPU?
Method CPU-only runs; one borrowed laptop
Output F1–F5

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
WORKSHOP · weeks 5–6
Q Does the review interface help researchers
catch errors, and is the draft useful?
Method sessions with 4–5 researchers: blind ratings,
planted errors with and without the evidence panel
Output H6–H8 (descriptive)

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHOWROOM · January
Q Do the design principles hold beyond this case?
Method expert validation
Output generic design guidance

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Answer to the main question, and design principles:
compute before you generate · flag, never rewrite
score against the ceiling
